description: This file defines a CsvExporter class responsible for exporting board data to CSV format, including generating CSV content from board, cards, and view data, and handling the download process.

classes.name: CsvExporter
classes.description: A utility class for exporting board data as CSV files, including methods for generating CSV content and triggering downloads.

methods.name: exportTableCsv
methods.description: Exports the specified board view and cards as a CSV file, creating a downloadable link and handling browser-specific behavior.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes text for CSV compatibility by escaping quotes and replacing hash symbols.

methods.name: generateTableArray
methods.description: Generates a 2D array representing the CSV data, including headers and card properties based on the view and board configuration.
